description:
FAMEAIS is the renewed FAME+ Erasmus Mundus programme — functional advanced materials engineering now with artificial intelligence for sustainability — organised by UCLouvain, Grenoble INP, TU Darmstadt, Augsburg and Aveiro. Its application round closes in January each year, with the exact date on the admissions page.

Programme Highlights

  • Twenty-year FAME tradition renewed with an AI-for-sustainability layer
  • Five-university consortium across Belgium, France, Germany and Portugal
  • January closing pattern for the scholarship round
  • Graduates in materials R&D, energy materials and AI-driven design

Who Should Apply

Materials, chemistry, physics and engineering graduates are the core audience; programming interest helps with the new AI components.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the FAMEAIS admissions page for the January cut-off and apply through the consortium form. Key deadline information: Application deadline falls in January for the following autumn (annual cycle) — exact date on the admissions page.
